configuration.direct_prompt: From this street-level image, guess its location anywhere on Earth. Return exactly one JSON object with the two-letter country code first, then the decimal latitude and longitude. Make one best guess. Use exactly these keys: country, latitude, longitude.
configuration.ocr_prompt: Transcribe up to three short location-relevant strings that are actually visible in this photo: place or street names, route numbers with a visible route sign, addresses on buildings, web domains, or distinctive words on road signs or storefronts. Keep the original alphabet and spelling. Use the clearest text. Omit any unreadable words, generic numbers, license plates, camera overlays and watermarks. Do not guess a language or place. Return only a JSON object with key "text" and an array of strings as its value. Use {"text":[]} when no relevant text is readable.
configuration.evidence_prompt_template: Consider the following possible transcriptions from the same image, along with the rest of the scene. Treat these as observations and use them only if useful. They may contain reading errors; a sign pointing toward a destination need not be at that destination. Visible text:

rows.read_full: {"text":["Calle de la Candelaria","Calle de la Candelaria","Calle de la Candelaria"]}
